tagline: Self-administered and self-managed real estate company focused on ownership, operation, and acquisition of self-storage properties
hero_kpi_rationale: Notable figure of 1,524 properties owned or managed (662 owned properties + 862 managed for third parties), demonstrating CubeSmart's operational scale and strong market position in the U.S. self-storage sector.

kpis.name: Nombre total de propriétés détenues et gérées
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties owned or managed (including 662 owned properties and 862 managed for third parties)
kpis.description: Total number of self-storage properties owned or managed by CubeSmart as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Growth of real estate portfolio and management capacity

kpis.name: Superficie locative totale
kpis.explanation: Total rentable square footage of owned properties, expressed in millions of square feet
kpis.description: Total rentable square footage of 48.4 million square feet across 662 properties owned by CubeSmart as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Size and capacity of the owned real estate portfolio

kpis.name: Taux d'occupation
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rentable square footage leased to customers
kpis.description: Occupancy rate of 88.1% of rentable square footage as of December 31, 2025, leased to approximately 399,000 customers
kpis.signal: Strong leasing demand and portfolio utilization

kpis.name: Dépenses en capital prévues
kpis.explanation: Projected recurring capital expenditures for 2026, expressed in millions of dollars
kpis.description: Expected recurring capital expenditures between $27.5 million and $32.5 million for the 2026 fiscal year
kpis.signal: Level of operational investment and portfolio maintenance

kpis.name: Dette totale
kpis.explanation: Total principal balance of unsecured notes and mortgage loans
kpis.description: Total principal balance of debt as of December 31, 2025 ($2,950 million in unsecured notes + $95.286 million in mortgage loans)

kpis.name: Rapport de couverture des intérêts minimum
kpis.explanation: Minimum interest coverage ratio required by debt agreements (covenant)
kpis.description: Minimum interest coverage ratio of 1.5x required by unsecured note covenants (not the actual ratio, but the covenant threshold)
kpis.signal: Minimum contractual obligation for debt service capacity

kpis.name: Nombre total de propriétés détenues et gérées
kpis.explanation: Nombre total de propriétés détenues ou gérées (incluant 662 propriétés détenues et 862 propriétés gérées pour des tiers)
kpis.description: Nombre total de propriétés de self-stockage détenues ou gérées par CubeSmart au 31 décembre 2025
kpis.signal: Croissance du portefeuille immobilier et de la capacité de gestion

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors (Item 1A), language is strong (significantly and negatively affect), and current economic context justifies particular attention. This risk is weighted as major for a real estate company.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and integrations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with several sub-points (closing conditions, unforeseen costs, integration, hidden liabilities) in Item 1A. The intensity of language (risks associated, integration challenges) and frequency of acquisitions in the sector justify high severity.

risks.title: Dependence on external financing
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated in Item 1A as a critical dependence (depend on external sources of capital which are outside our control). Financial market uncertainty and impact on acquisitions, debt service, and distributions justify high severity.

risks.title: Increased competition in markets
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well-developed in Item 1A, mentioning competition from self-storage developers and operators. The potential impact on occupancy rates and rental prices is emphasized. Severity is moderate as it is a constant risk in this sector.

risks.title: Geographic concentration risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly identifies concentration of revenues in a few states (NY, FL, TX, CA). The language (particularly susceptible) indicates increased vulnerability to adverse local conditions, justifying moderate to high severity.

risks.title: Insufficient or costly insurance coverage
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A details coverage limitations for certain risks (natural disasters, terrorism) and rising costs. Inability to cover significant losses or meet loan covenants is a significant risk.

risks.title: Joint venture risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described in Item 1A, highlighting loss of control, potential conflicts of interest with partners, and litigation risks. While less central than macro risks, it represents a source of complexity and financial risk.

ai_positioning.summary: CubeSmart does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. There is no indication of AI use or integration in its operations or products.
